en.headline: Harbour roads shut and MTR exits closed ahead of fireworks
en.dek: Police staged closures on both sides of Victoria Harbour were in force by early evening, and the MTR shut selected Tsim Sha Tsui and West Kowloon exits.
body: Road closures for the National Day fireworks were in force across the harbourfront by early Thursday evening, with the display due to start at 8pm. RTHK traffic reports said several Tsim Sha Tsui streets were already closed and that Salisbury Road, Canton Road, Nathan Road, Austin Road and Lin Cheung Road were congested. Police had said they expected about 260,000 people along both shores.

On Hong Kong Island, staged closures and diversions in Central, Wan Chai and the Eastern District began at 4pm. In Kowloon, closures around the West Kowloon Cultural District and Tsim Sha Tsui began at 5pm and were due to stay until crowds dispersed and roads could reopen. RTHK said some ferry sailings would be cancelled, brought forward or delayed between 5.05pm and 9.30pm.

The MTR closed selected exits to match police crowd control. At Tsim Sha Tsui station, exits H and R were shut. At East Tsim Sha Tsui, exits J, L1, L3, L4, L5, L6, N3 and P3 were shut. At Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, exit F, the Sky Corridor and the viewing deck were closed.

Police had warned that illegally parked vehicles blocking traffic could be towed without prior notice, and asked people going to the harbour to use public transport. The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau is coordinating the 23-minute display, which is due to launch more than 30,000 shells from barges and pontoons over the harbour.

zh.headline: 煙花前維港兩岸封路 港鐵關閉部分出口
zh.dek: 國慶煙花晚上8時開始，警方分階段封路已生效；港鐵關閉尖沙咀、尖東及西九龍站部分出口。
body: 國慶煙花匯演周四晚上8時在維港舉行，傍晚前兩岸封路已經展開。香港電台交通消息指，尖沙咀多條街道正在實施封路，梳士巴利道、廣東道、彌敦道、柯士甸道及連翔道車多。警方早前估計，維港兩岸約有26萬人觀賞。
港島中區、灣仔及東區由下午4時起分階段封路及改道。九龍西九文化區及尖沙咀一帶由下午5時起封路，直至人潮散去、道路可以重開。電台又指，部分渡輪班次由下午5時05分至晚上9時30分會取消、提早或延遲。
港鐵配合警方人潮管制，關閉部分出入口。尖沙咀站關閉H及R出口；尖東站關閉J、L1、L3、L4、L5、L6、N3及P3出口；香港西九龍站關閉F出口、天空走廊及觀景台。
警方早前表示，違泊或阻礙交通的車輛可能不予警告即時拖走，並呼籲市民盡量乘公共交通前往。匯演由文化體育及旅遊局統籌，約23分鐘，將由躉船及浮船發放逾3萬枚煙花。
